evidence.method: Native indexed glTF triangles decoded with shared node transforms. Exact horizontal triangle-union intersection and 1m interior vertical-ray samples. No convex-hull proxy.
evidence.qualification: Triangle presence can be another storey or underside. The canopy has no surveyed height, so correspondence and suppression still require explicit source/visual review.

interpretation: Tower is a source component on its separately modelled podium. Bare-ground clearance is not evidence of floating placement; publish the two source models together. Ground-floor terrain remains approximate at70m; no region sign-off.
